blocks.orig: Lemala Nanyukie Tented Lodge lies in central Serengeti, where it is superbly located on a grassy savanna dotted with rocky kopjes and shaded by ancient giant acacia trees. Here it offers outstanding views across the fascinating endless plains of the Serengeti.
blocks.html: In central Serengeti, Lemala Nanyukie Tented Lodge enjoys a superb setting on a grassy savanna scattered with rocky kopjes and shaded by old, giant acacia trees. From here you have excellent views over the captivating, endless Serengeti plains.

blocks.orig: The 15 spacious and luxurious canvas tents boast a lovely interior with an oversized bed and an indoor and outdoor shower in the ensuite bathroom. Take a warm bath on cold days in the freestanding bath tub with a view or dive in your own plunge pool in the corner of the outside terrace, for a view on warm days. The comfortable lounge and bar and outdoor viewing deck in the public area lead to a refreshing public swimming pool, and to the indoor and outdoor dining areas. An amazing place!
blocks.html: Its 15 roomy, luxury canvas tents have an attractive interior with an extra-large bed and an ensuite bathroom with both an indoor and an outdoor shower. On chilly days, have a warm soak in the freestanding bathtub with a view, and on warm days take a dip in your own plunge pool in the corner of the outdoor terrace, view included. In the shared area, the comfortable lounge, the bar and the outdoor viewing deck lead to a refreshing swimming pool and to the indoor and outdoor dining spaces. A wonderful place!
